title: BatchCommand
description: Explicit commands for 1-32 distinct devices. Core checks device/request uniqueness, derived child IDs, grants, and replay conflicts before sending. The host Operation supplies the total budget.

request_id.description: Caller-supplied IDs must be nonblank and at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, checked by Core. Internal composite receipt IDs append a colon and step index after input validation and may exceed that caller limit; they are not new standalone requests.

arguments.description: Must satisfy the selected device action schema and one complete trusted grant. Commands cannot supply or expand grants.

connection.description: Requested route policy; it never grants authority. Core intersects it with trusted component/argument/route grants and action support.
